compliancePosture: Aggregate region-level statistics only; no individual sold prices; every figure n>=5. Cite figures verbatim.

angles.headline: 45% of active Whitby listings have cut their asking price
angles.whySurprising: Highest price-cut share of the 15 markets tracked today.

angles.headline: The typical active Whitby listing has now sat 18 days
angles.whySurprising: Longest median true days-on-market of the markets tracked today.

angles.headline: Toronto is sitting at 0.1 months of supply
angles.whySurprising: Least inventory of the 15 markets tracked today — ≈4–6 months is balanced, and below that tilts hard toward sellers.

angles.headline: A 1-bed in Ottawa grosses about 7.1% rental yield
angles.whySurprising: Best gross rental yield of the markets tracked today (1-bed).
